# NEW 2026-11-23 v17.0 Module 17.0-B: Situational Soundtrack Bridge (oe_aud2_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v170_soundtrack.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Zero-slot yearly kernel hook (invoked once per calendar year from oe_gk_yearly_dispatch).
# Self-deduplicates via global_var:oe_aud2_ran_y ?= current_year.
# Sets region-aware oe_aud2_active_suite (1..5) and era progression oe_aud2_symphony_era (1..5),
# and dispatches cultural patronage events without calling uncompiled Wwise events.
oe_aud2_kernel_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { global_var:oe_aud2_ran_y ?= current_year }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_aud2_ran_y value = current_year }
		oe_aud2_update_global_era = yes
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_rebel_country = no
				OR = {
					is_ai = no
					AND = {
						is_subject = no
						OR = {
							is_great_power = yes
							num_locations >= 25
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_aud2_suite_locked } }
				oe_aud2_refresh_region_suite = yes
			}
			oe_aud2_sync_country_era = yes
			oe_aud2_cultural_patronage_tick = yes
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Tracks global musical era progression (1=Medieval, 2=Renaissance, 3=Baroque, 4=Classical, 5=Symphonic Finale).
oe_aud2_update_global_era = {
	if = {
		limit = { current_year < 1450 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_aud2_symphony_era value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { current_year < 1600 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_aud2_symphony_era value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { current_year < 1720 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_aud2_symphony_era value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { current_year < 1790 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_aud2_symphony_era value = 4 }
	}
	else = {
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_aud2_symphony_era value = 5 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Mirrors current musical era (1..5) onto country state for clean UI/script inspection.
oe_aud2_sync_country_era = {
	if = {
		limit = { current_year < 1450 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_aud2_symphony_era value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { current_year < 1600 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_aud2_symphony_era value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { current_year < 1720 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_aud2_symphony_era value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { current_year < 1790 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_aud2_symphony_era value = 4 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_aud2_symphony_era value = 5 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Assigns region-aware suite mood variable oe_aud2_active_suite (1..5):
#   1 = Byzantine Liturgical Chant & Imperial Brass
#   2 = East Asian Guqin, Pipa & Palace Drums
#   3 = Persian Santur & Steppe Horsehead Fiddle
#   4 = Indian Sitar & Monsoon Raga
#   5 = European Baroque Organ & Grand Finale Strings
oe_aud2_refresh_region_suite = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				tag = BYZ
				tag = ROM
				AND = {
					exists = capital
					capital = { region = region:balkan_region }
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_aud2_active_suite value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			capital = {
				OR = {
					region = region:north_china_region
					region = region:east_china_region
					region = region:south_china_region
					region = region:west_china_region
					region = region:manchuria_region
					region = region:korea_region
					region = region:japan_region
					region = region:tibet_region
					sub_continent = sub_continent:south_east_asia
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_aud2_active_suite value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			capital = {
				OR = {
					sub_continent = sub_continent:central_asia
					sub_continent = sub_continent:middle_east
					region = region:steppes_region
					region = region:mongolia_region
					region = region:xinjiang_region
					region = region:caucasus_region
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_aud2_active_suite value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			capital = { sub_continent = sub_continent:south_asia }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_aud2_active_suite value = 4 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_aud2_active_suite value = 5 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Cycles player suite preference 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 -> 5 -> auto-regional reset.
oe_aud2_cycle_suite = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_aud2_active_suite } }
		oe_aud2_refresh_region_suite = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:oe_aud2_active_suite ?= 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_aud2_active_suite value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_aud2_suite_locked value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:oe_aud2_active_suite ?= 2 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_aud2_active_suite value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_aud2_suite_locked value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:oe_aud2_active_suite ?= 3 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_aud2_active_suite value = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_aud2_suite_locked value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:oe_aud2_active_suite ?= 4 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_aud2_active_suite value = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_aud2_suite_locked value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_aud2_suite_locked }
			remove_variable = oe_aud2_suite_locked
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_aud2_active_suite value = 1 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Fires at most one cultural music patronage milestone event per year per realm.
oe_aud2_cultural_patronage_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			oe_main_mod_old_world_event_allowed = yes
			oe_years_since_start >= 10
			current_year >= 1360
			var:oe_aud2_active_suite ?= 1
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_aud2_ev1_done }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_aud2_ev1_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_aud2.1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			oe_main_mod_old_world_event_allowed = yes
			oe_years_since_start >= 10
			current_year >= 1380
			var:oe_aud2_active_suite ?= 2
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_aud2_ev2_done }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_aud2_ev2_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_aud2.2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			oe_main_mod_old_world_event_allowed = yes
			oe_years_since_start >= 10
			current_year >= 1400
			OR = {
				var:oe_aud2_active_suite ?= 3
				var:oe_aud2_active_suite ?= 4
			}
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_aud2_ev3_done }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_aud2_ev3_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_aud2.3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			oe_main_mod_old_world_event_allowed = yes
			oe_years_since_start >= 10
			current_year >= 1650
			OR = {
				var:oe_aud2_active_suite ?= 5
				is_great_power = yes
			}
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_aud2_ev4_done }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_aud2_ev4_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_aud2.4
	}
}
